title: Will AI derail global climate goals?
purpose: Help the user stay informed about current developments without reading the full article.

output.audience: An informed non-specialist reader following current developments
output.format: Well-structured prose with descriptive headings and optional sparing bullet points

strengths: Clear central thesis and several numeric claims
Distinct observations, model results, scenarios and recommendations
Enough conceptual structure to test more than sentence extraction
limitations: Publisher-provided key findings make the task easier
The source is an institutional press release about a forthcoming book chapter, not an independent review
English-to-German output combines comprehension, translation and summarization
